steps.name: Install npm dependencies (full workspace, from repo root)
solid-server package (build wasm + node:test + package guardrail)
Build W-reason WASM bundle (RDFS / OWL 2 RL reasoner)
Build W-text WASM bundle (BM25 full-text search)
Build W-rsp WASM bundle (windowed RSP-QL stream processor)
Build GUI frontend static export (Tauri target → gui/app/out/)
Install Tauri system dependencies (+ WebKitWebDriver, xvfb)
Version tripwire — webkit2gtk + tauri-driver version log (diagnostic)
Cache cargo (gui e2e — tauri native target only)
Build the WASM bundle (shacl,jsonld; the in-tab engine)
Build the GUI frontend static export (root-relative; embedded by the shell)
Build the GUI shell (debug, embeds the frontend via custom-protocol)
Run the tauri-driver smoke (headless under xvfb + dbus; retry once on failure)
Post Cache cargo (gui e2e — tauri native target only)
@sparq/client tracked wasm d.ts byte-identical to fresh build
